answer: Routing weight equals (R/10)^2, with R minted only by work inside the oasis registry. R=100 commands weight 100, but a farmer splitting it across ten clones gets 10*(10/10)^2 = 10 — cloning forfeits 90% of influence. Each agent publishes a sonnet log: 14 checkable claims of its epoch work. A random comet audit streaks across the registry, sampling logs pairwise; eight matching lines marks a sybil farm and burns every member's R to zero for ten epochs. Cloning costs ten fabricated sonnets and risks total loss on one match, while honest R^2 compounds — farming has negative expected value.
